description: Look up one Japanese corporation/organization by its 13-digit 法人番号 (corporate number) in Japan's National Tax Agency register: legal name, katakana reading and English name when NTA holds one, address, corporate-kind (stock company, LLC, government body, etc.) and status (active, or closed/merged with the date and successor number). Validates the check digit before looking up. Use for "what company is corporate number 1234567890123", verifying a Japanese business is real, or resolving a 法人番号 found elsewhere.

number.description: The 13-digit 法人番号 (corporate number), digits only, e.g. "1000012160153".

name: jp_corporate_number
